description: UCI row 4 (age 53, HIGH vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 1) — leveraged etf 3x: hard fails ['R1', 'R4', 'R5', 'R7'] -> UNSUITABLE
client_narrative: Pita Havili is 53 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 32,600 euros (around 2,717 euros per month). They hold 2,400 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 6,200 euros with a 2-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has basic investment experience, limited to savings accounts, fixed-term deposits, and simple fixed-income products. Their investment approach is very conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 1 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 6,200 euros invested. They have been assessed as financially vulnerable.
product_narrative: The product is a leveraged exchange-traded product providing 3x daily leveraged exposure to the S&P 500 index through financial derivatives and daily rebalancing. Due to compounding effects, returns over periods beyond one day can diverge significantly from three times the index return, and total loss of invested capital is possible in adverse market conditions. The product is classified COMPLEX under MiFID II and requires advanced investor knowledge. It is designed as a short-term speculative instrument; the minimum recommended holding period is one year.
